startUrls.title: Community URLs
startUrls.description: List of Skool community URLs to process. Example: https://www.skool.com/community-name

limit.title: Max results
limit.description: Maximum number of results to return. Lower values cost less.

requestTimeout.title: Request timeout
requestTimeout.description: How long to wait for each page to load, in seconds.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Skool requires residential proxies. Datacenter proxies will be blocked by AWS WAF.
